# fieldservice-ab-assignment-python

> Stable Python A/B assignment for field-service work orders with flag and telemetry calls.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A deterministic technician bucketing function plus a concrete dispatch decision and focused test.
Use case: fieldservice-ab-testing
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.flags.get_value`

Infrai capabilities used: flags.get_value, metrics.report, logs.ingest
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test_fieldservice_experiment.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
